<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Wow, you’re working really hard on this town,
<$cdef(27)>!
Can
I
ask
for
something too?

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Yayyy, thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>So, um, I want you to make a crop field and plant some
vegetables! <$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Any kind would work!

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Yayyy, thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>So, um, I want you to make a crop field and plant some
vegetables! <$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Any kind would work!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh, and can you make the crop field somewhere close
enough to walk to from the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,8)>Anywhere on the same island is OK!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,10)>Come tell me when the veggies sprout, OK?
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Or actually, if you take me to where you planted the
seeds, <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>I can help make them sprout!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>I want you to make a crop field and plant some vegetables!
And then I wanna see the sprouts!

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Please make the crop field close enough to walk to
from the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>And if you take me to where you planted the seeds, I can
help make them sprout!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Yippee! You made such a great crop field! Awww, the
veggies are so CUTE! <$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,8)>Thank you, thank you!

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, heyyy, <$cdef(27)>. I wanted to talk
to
you
about something...

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,5)>I really like to fly around while the sun’s out, but I always
oversleeeeeep because <$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,4)>I’m so bad at waking up earlyyy...

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>I heard those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> things the huuumans
used help you wake up earlyyy, so...
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,7)>Could you bring me <$cdef(27)>five <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>,
<$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Thaaanks, <$cdef(27)>. With <$cdef(27)>five
<$ifull(1702)>,
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>I’ll
never
oversleep agaaaiiin...

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Yeahhh, you know... Just to be saaafe...
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>With <$cdef(27)>five <$ifull(1702)>, I’ll probably definitely be able
to wake up earlyyy...

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Actuallyyy, when I was flying over by the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center,
I think I heard a weeeiiird noise coming from the <$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)><$cdef(27)>cave
on the back side of the island...
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Do you think that could’ve been an <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>?

<$emotion(4,41)><$voicel(4,3)>I’m too biiig, so I couldn’t fit inside the cave...
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>But I bet you could use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(11)> to get in. You should
go look fooor it...
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>It was over near a waterfall...

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>I’ll be waiting patiently for my <$cdef(27)>five <$ifull(1702)>...
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>If you could put all <$cdef(27)>fiiive near my home, that would be
really greeeaaat.

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>When I was flying near the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center, I actually
found a <$cdef(27)>cave on the baaack side of the island...
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,8)>I bet you could find some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)> in theeere...

<$emotion(4,1)><$voicel(4,9)>Wooow... Thanks for the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1702)>,
<$cdef(27)>.
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,8)>Now I’ll neeever oversleep again...

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>I just have to be careful to not turn them off with my
<$cdef(27)>Hyyyper Beam... Heheheee...
